summary.text: Trent Davis is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 156 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Brian Seitz.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Davis said he is a Branson native who has worked in the service industry and wants to increase public education funding and teacher pay.

paragraphs.text: Trent Davis earned a high school diploma from Hollister High School, and his career experience includes working in customer service.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is an Eagle Scout, a father of three daughters, and has been married for almost 15 years.
Davis is the Democratic nominee for the seat.

His survey responses named three key messages: putting more public money into public education and raising teacher pay to the national average, with universal school breakfast and lunch; capping corporate purchases of housing and funding construction of more homes; and addressing water pollution in the lakes and watershed of his district.
He also said he is passionate about child safety and would work with local law enforcement on trafficking cases.
